permissible_purpose: FCRA - Collection of a debt / judgment enforcement
task: Locate current physical address and employment for judgment debtor Marcus Whitfield (DOB 1982-04-17) owing $18,400 on default judgment #2024-CH-3389, last known address in Joliet, IL.

notes.author: S. Kowalski
notes.note: Intake - judgment amount confirmed $18,400. Last phone contact in March 2026, debtor stated he would pay after tax return. No payment received. USPS NCOA shows Hammond, IN address as of 10/15/2025.

notes.author: S. Kowalski
notes.note: Ran full TLOxp search. Asset search shows two vehicles - one IL, one IN registration. Possible employment at framing company based on wage verification records from 2025.

notes.author: J. Perez
notes.note: Attempted field visit to 3577 Ashford Dr, Hammond, IN on 09/14. Observed a female occupant, refused to confirm if Marcus lives there. Neighbor stated 'Marcus moved out in August'.

notes.author: S. Kowalski
notes.note: Ran utility header search on Hammond address - no utility account in Marcus's name. Woman at residence likely renting. Placed investigative call to Midwestern Framing - HR confirmed no current employee by that name. Possible he left position in August.

permissible_purpose: FCRA - Employment screening with signed consent (CRA)
task: Verify employment history and residential addresses for James Hendricks (DOB 1999-12-02) applying for warehouse manager position at Rapid Logistics Group, Bensenville, IL.

notes.author: M. Nguyen
notes.note: FCRA disclosure and authorization signed electronically on 09/12/2026. Candidate provided SSN and DOB. Screening requested includes employment history, address verification, criminal record search, and driving record.

notes.author: M. Nguyen
notes.note: Employment verification - UPS confirms employment from 2023-08 through 2025-08, left voluntarily. Amazon confirms 2021-06 through 2023-06, left for UPS. No reported discrepancies.

notes.author: M. Nguyen
notes.note: Address verification complete - all three addresses confirmed via utility and NCOA records. No gaps in residential history > 60 days.

notes.author: M. Nguyen
notes.note: Criminal record check - no convictions found in any county searched (Cook, Kane, DuPage). Driving record - valid IL license, no major violations. Case complete, report issued to client.

permissible_purpose: GLBA - Fraud investigation / insurance claim verification
task: Surveillance of claimant Luis Mendez (DOB 1979-09-10) to document physical activity and functional capacity - claim alleges back injury preventing work.

notes.author: D. O'Malley
notes.note: Intake - Claim #WC-2025-88934. Injured on 01/12/2026 while lifting drywall at job site. Diagnosis - lumbar strain/herniated disc. Claimant states unable to lift more than 10 lbs, cannot sit/stand for prolonged periods. Prescribed PT and pain medication.

notes.author: R. Hastings
notes.note: Pre-surveillance - reviewed claim file. Suspected exaggeration. Pt. was seen by IME doc in August who noted 'inconsistent physical findings'. Surveillance approved for 5 days.

notes.author: D. O'Malley
notes.note: Day 1 - Claimant observed leaving residence at 7:15am driving Dodge Ram. Parked at Home Depot in Gurnee, IL. Walked through store normally, no visible limp, lifted several large boxes (estimated >30 lbs) and placed in shopping cart without difficulty.

notes.author: R. Hastings
notes.note: Day 2 - Observed claimant at a residential renovation site at 1215 White Oak Ln, Antioch, IL. Subject was carrying 2x4 lumber, drywall sheets, and operating a drill/driver. Hours observed: 8:30am to 3:45pm with normal work breaks.

notes.author: R. Hastings
notes.note: Day 3 - Surveillance continued at same Antioch site. Subject manually loaded drywall from supplier onto hand truck, then into garage. Also observed bending, squatting, and kneeling repeatedly. No observable physical limitations.

notes.author: D. O'Malley
notes.note: Day 4 - No activity. Claimant's vehicle was at home all day. No visitors observed.

notes.author: R. Hastings
notes.note: Day 5 - Same residential site in Antioch. Claimant performing drywall finishing, sanding, and lifting sheets. Worked from 9am to 5pm. Video and photographic documentation obtained. Report being compiled for client.

field_logs.observation: Subject left 7834 Orchard Ln at 07:15 in Dodge Ram. Drove to Home Depot, Gurnee. Walked normally throughout store, lifted large boxes (est. 30-40 lbs) from bottom shelf unassisted. Placed items in cart. At checkout, subject lifted bags of cement mix with clear ease.

Subject arrived 08:20 at 1215 White Oak Ln, Antioch. Site appears to be a gut rehab. Subject carried six sheets of drywall from truck to garage. Also observed carrying two 2x4 lumber pieces over 30 minutes. No signs of discomfort or limitation.

At 08:30, subject used a hand truck to move 10+ bundles of drywall from delivery truck into garage. Also observed crouching and standing repeatedly while measuring and cutting drywall with caster knife. Subject climbed a ladder to reach second floor - no difficulty.
No movement. Subject's truck remained in driveway of 7834 Orchard Ln throughout the day. No activity observed.lights on at 8pm.

Subject at same Antioch site. Worked on drywall finishing - sanding ceilings with a pole sander, applying joint compound, lifting mixed buckets weighing approx. 20 lbs. Continual work for approximately 4 hours without breaks exceeding 10 minutes.

permissible_purpose: FCRA - Judgment collection / locating assets of judgment debtor
task: Identify bank accounts, property holdings, and business interests for Michael Osei (DOB 1976-11-23) to enforce judgment of $25,700 for unpaid commercial lease damages.

notes.author: M. Rivera
notes.note: Intake - Case stems from unpaid lease at strip mall in Bloomingdale, IL. Judgment entered 04/12/2026. Defendant has not paid and allegedly moved from Downers Grove after sale of residence.

notes.author: M. Rivera
notes.note: Asset search initiated. IL Secretary of State shows registered business entity - Oakbrook Global Trading Corp, registered agent address at 2204 North Bend Ct (old address). Business principal listed as Michael Osei.

notes.author: C. Foster
notes.note: Financial asset search - TLOxp indicates possible bank account at Chase Bank - found checks paid on business account. Also has personal account at Fifth Third. Sent subpoena fixture request to client.

notes.author: M. Rivera
notes.note: Property search - Cook County and DuPage County records show no real estate owned in subject's name. However, business entity owns warehouse at 9910 Cliffside Rd, Elk Grove Village, IL. Judgment order attached to business may be enforceable against the entity.

permissible_purpose: Litigation support - locating eyewitness to motor vehicle accident
task: Locate and interview witness Gregory Fields (DOB 1989-05-30) who was a passenger on a CTA bus that was struck by a vehicle at Pulaski Rd and Peterson Ave, Chicago on 07/15/2026.

notes.author: T. Brooks
notes.note: Intake - Client representing injured driver in accident at Pulaski/Peterson. CTA bus #1342 broadsided plaintiff's vehicle. Witness was sitting near front of bus, made initial statement to responding officer that 'bus ran red light'. Police report lists witness contact as (773) 555-0133.

notes.author: T. Brooks
notes.note: Phone number disconnected or not in service. Attempted call - got error code 44. Need updated contact info. Ran TLOxp - address history shows 6588 N Talbrook Ave as current for utilities.

notes.author: J. Watson
notes.note: Field visit to 6588 N Talbrook Ave - subject not home. Left business card with roommate. Roommate confirmed Gregory lives there and works for City of Chicago - Streets & Sanitation department.

notes.author: J. Watson
notes.note: Called Streets & Sanitation dept. directly. Was transferred to Alderman's office who confirmed Gregory works as sanitation worker, assigned to a yard in Logan Square. Left message for him to call back.

notes.author: T. Brooks
notes.note: Gregory called back on 10/04. Agreed to meet for interview on 10/08 at our office. Confirmed he saw the bus run the red light - willing to testify. Sending written summary to client.

permissible_purpose: Litigation support - verify current address for service of process (divorce petition)
task: Verify current physical address for Sarah Kowalski-Grant (DOB 1986-02-14) last known residence at 4308 Redwood Ct, Munster, IN - divorce petition to be served.

notes.author: A. Novak
notes.note: Intake - Client seeking address verification for service at divorce proceedings. Respondent was previously served at 4308 Redwood Ct, Munster on 05/15/2026 but moved. Spouse's attorney provided new possible address in Schererville, IN.

notes.author: A. Novak
notes.note: Checked USPS NCOA - confirmed change of address from 4308 Redwood Ct to 1277 Sandpiper Pkwy, Schererville on 08/01/2026. NCOA shows 10-day hold but no forwarding shown.

notes.author: A. Novak
notes.note: Verified utility account in subject's name at 1277 Sandpiper Pkwy. called phone number (219) 555-0193 - received voicemail in subject's name. Confirms residence.

notes.author: A. Novak
notes.note: Contacted Community Healthcare System - verified subject's employment as RN. Provided work address for service if needed. Confirmed subject works at St. Catherine's Hospital in East Chicago, IN.

task: Verify physical operations, equipment inventory, and key-supplier relationships of Midwest Tool & Die Co. at 230 W. Larkspur Avenue, Hammond, IN.

notes.author: K. Ramirez
notes.note: Initial site visit confirmed active operations at 230 W. Larkspur Ave. Bldg appears well-maintained, 3 forklifts visible, scrap metal bins staged at rear.

notes.author: K. Ramirez
notes.note: Interviewed 2 floor workers off-site - both confirmed full-time employment, mentioned pending 3rd shift being added next month. Passed to analysis.

notes.author: J. Okafor
notes.note: Received vendor list from subject's accounting dept under NDA. Cross-referencing with public supplier contracts shows 80% overlap with stated clients.

notes.author: M. Delgado
notes.note: ACH summary for wholesale hardware supplier: average monthly order volume $180K, stable over last 12 months. Flag: two suppliers have same beneficial owner as Michalski - vertical integration not disclosed in first draft.

task: Report all locator, eviction-filing, and criminal-history data for Kendra Vasquez to client to assess lease renewal at 1820 W. Nettlefield Avenue, Apt 4, Waukegan, IL.

notes.author: L. Tran
notes.note: Search of Lake County, IL eviction court records: found a 2024 small-claims judgment for unpaid utilities from prior landlord, satisfied in full 06/2024. No eviction filings found.

notes.author: L. Tran
notes.note: Criminal history search in Lake County IL, Kenosha Co WI, and statewide: zero convictions. One 2021 traffic citation for expired plates, paid.

notes.author: R. Hodge
notes.note: Employment verified at Crestline Nursing Center - 32 hrs/week, FT since 08/2024. Income meets 2.5x rent threshold.

notes.author: L. Tran
notes.note: Closed: recommendation to approve lease renewal. Reported credit score 682 (Vantage 3.0) via consumer report provided by client.

permissible_purpose: DPPA - consent of subject (subject is client's spouse; documented verbal consent)
task: Follow and document movements of Alexander J. Whitlock on Thursday and Friday evenings after 5:30 PM from his office at 4600 N. Ravenswood Ave, Chicago, to determine if he is meeting any person outside the marriage.

notes.author: D. Kowalski
notes.note: Intake - client reports husband staying late at office, behavior change. Consent form signed 09/28. Emphasis: only observe/documented, no harassment.

notes.author: D. Kowalski
notes.note: Confirmed subject's vehicle in office parking lot at 5:24 PM. Did not emerge until 6:45 PM. Third day of observation.

notes.author: P. O'Neil
notes.note: Thursday follow: subject left office, drove to Old Town, met a woman at Stan's Donuts on N. Clark St; sat together for 30 min, appeared affectionate. Clearshot photos taken.

notes.author: P. O'Neil
notes.note: Friday follow: subject drove directly to 'Lakeshore Fitness' at 5400 N. Sheridan Rd, stayed 45 min, then home. The woman from Thursday was also seen at the gym. Reported to client.

field_logs.observation: Parked at Metzner's Pub lot (BL 3600 N). Subject exited office bldg at 6:46 PM, drove east on Lawrence, then to N. Western Ave area. No apparent meeting, returned home at 8:50 PM.

Subject left office at 6:52 PM, drove to N. Clark St (Old Town). Met a female subject near 1300 block. They walked to Stan's Donuts, sat for ~30 min. Female identified later as same from fitness center. Subject returned home at 9:40 PM.

Subject left office at 6:18 PM with gym duffel bag. Drove to Lakeshore Fitness (5400 N Sheridan). Entered at 6:42 PM, left 7:28 PM. Same female from prior night was there (witnessed both entering). Subject drove home directly, arrived 7:50 PM, no other stops.

client: Banner Mutual Insurance Company - Special Investigations Unit
permissible_purpose: FCRA - insurance claim investigation (claim in progress with signed authorization)
task: Review all accessible public social media profiles for Marcus D. Elliot (claim #BX-4412) to identify evidence of physical activity contradicting reported disability from lumbar injury (back sprain) on 2026-08-14.

notes.author: S. Nakamura
notes.note: Facebook profile 'Marcus Elliot - Merrillville' - visible only to friends. Instagram public handle @marcus_d_elliot92 - last post was 08/28, photo of gym floor near bench press (no person). Flagged.

notes.author: S. Nakamura
notes.note: TikTok profile public - 3 videos from late September show walking a large dog in a park, lifting a ~20lb bag of dog food. No lifting weights. The park identified as Shady Knoll Park in Crown Point, IL based on sign.

notes.author: S. Nakamura
notes.note: LinkedIn shows employer change from 'Regional Contract Freight' to 'Freelance logistics consultant' - reported start date 09/01/2026. Contradicts claim of being fully disabled.

notes.author: S. Nakamura
notes.note: Compiled summary: Video evidence of bending/moving, ability to lift 20lb, and new professional role. Referred back to SIU manager for possible decision on surveillance need.

permissible_purpose: DPPA - legitimate need for location information (estate administration)
task: Locate current address and contact information for Pamela J. Kroger (maiden name 'Haugen'), last known in the Racine, WI area, regarding inheritance from deceased aunt Eleanor M. Haugen (estate #E-3392, Kenosha County Probate).

notes.author: D. Kim
notes.note: Probate court sent certified letter to last known address (2911 S. Vinehaven - returned 'forward expired + no known address'). Retaining us to locate.

notes.author: D. Kim
notes.note: Checked credit header (FCRA permissible for locate): last known address as of 2023 was Vinehaven Trail. Credit file shows name change to 'Kroger' since 2019. No additional addresses on file.

notes.author: D. Kim
notes.note: Contacted Brightwater Assisted Living - subject left employment in 2020 due to relocation 'to be closer to family in Indiana'. No forwarding info.

notes.author: D. Kim
notes.note: Posted notice in Racine Journal Times on 10/07. Checked voter registration statewide - no match found. Cited records from 2021 small claims case list her as defaulted defendant - address in that filing was a PO Box in Kenosha (unhelpful).
